text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia and acidemia (low pH, low arterial oxygen, low O2 saturation), mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and abnormal white cell differential (monocytosis, basophilia, low neutrophil and lymphocyte percentages). Creatinine is elevated, suggesting possible renal impairment. Liver enzymes are low but not clinically significant. COVID-19 PCR is negative. Findings suggest acute respiratory failure with possible underlying infection or systemic process; urgent clinical evaluation is recommended.
